name: openswmm-engine
description: Open Storm Water Management Model Engine — data-oriented, plugin-extensible, reentrant C++20 engine built on the EPA SWMM 5.x foundation.

2d.description: 2D surface routing module (SUNDIALS/CVODE solver + HDF5 for CF-1.11/UGRID-1.0 output)

tests.description: Unit and regression test harness (Google Test)

geopackage.description: GeoPackage I/O support (SQLite-based spatial model persistence)

gpu.description: GPU surface-solver plugin backend (Phase 1, OpenMP): Kokkos host-parallel layer plus SUNDIALS with the Kokkos N_Vector. Non-default; pulled only with --x-feature=gpu. Produces a separately loaded plugin, not linked into the base library. Build the plugin with -DOPENSWMM_GPU_BACKEND=omp.

gpu-cuda.description: GPU surface-solver plugin backend (Phase 2, CUDA): Kokkos CUDA device layer plus SUNDIALS with the Kokkos N_Vector. Non-default; --x-feature=gpu-cuda. Requires the CUDA toolkit and OPENSWMM_KOKKOS_CUDA_ARCH; build the plugin with -DOPENSWMM_GPU_BACKEND=cuda on a CUDA host/CI (not macOS).

gpu-hip.description: GPU surface-solver plugin backend (Phase 5, HIP/AMD): Kokkos HIP device layer plus SUNDIALS with the Kokkos N_Vector. Non-default; --x-feature=gpu-hip. Requires ROCm and OPENSWMM_KOKKOS_HIP_ARCH; build the plugin with -DOPENSWMM_GPU_BACKEND=hip on a ROCm host/CI (not macOS).

gpu-sycl.description: GPU surface-solver plugin backend (Phase 5, SYCL/Intel): Kokkos SYCL device layer plus SUNDIALS with the Kokkos N_Vector. Non-default; --x-feature=gpu-sycl. Requires the oneAPI toolkit and OPENSWMM_KOKKOS_SYCL_ARCH; build the plugin with -DOPENSWMM_GPU_BACKEND=sycl on an Intel-GPU host/CI (not macOS).

hypre.description: hypre BoomerAMG algebraic-multigrid preconditioner for the 2D surface solver (PRECONDITIONER=AMG). Non-default; --x-feature=hypre with -DOPENSWMM_WITH_HYPRE=ON. Pulls hypre (and its BLAS/LAPACK, plus an MPI stack on ports that require it); called sequentially via MPI_COMM_SELF.
